markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (94%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Prominent benign stroma drives this call, with clear simulated frozen-section margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 94%, InSitu 3%, Invasive 2% [F1] | Low invasive carcinoma risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% coverage (n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 66th percentile OOD [F6] | Typical input despite resample degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (87%–89%); contrast InSitu (79%) [F5] | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score strongly opposes invasion (20/20 spot check) [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score nudges toward invasion (18/20 spot check) [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score nudges toward invasion (12/20 spot check) [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Low score opposes invasion; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-risk regions drops invasive score above random (95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); ignore unreliable mitoses and normal lobules (both 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Resample degradation (severity 3) masks in situ changes like contrast case BACH_0043 (InSitu, 79% match).
- Focal atypia involves the medial margin segment in region 4 (96% score vs 100% threshold).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 11, 6**: Inspect highest-risk regions (up to 1% risk) and region 6 stroma.
2. **Regions 5, 2**: Verify normal ducts where low tubule and duct-confined scores favored invasion.
3. **Regions 4, 8, 9**: Confirm clear medial (96%) and inferior (69%) simulated margin segments.
